notes.title: Ember Crusade IV: Patch 2 and Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 2[/h2]
Patch 2 for Ember Crusade IV adds some new settings to the Config menu, namely support for windowed mode as well as some accessibility settings.

To find these settings, go to the main menu and click on Config. You will see the following new settings:
[list]
[*] Windowed mode - toggles windowed mode for Ember Crusade IV
[*] Invincibility - makes you invincible [i]until you restart the game[/i]
[*] One hit kills - kills enemies in one hit [i]until you restart the game[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Demo[/h2]
A new demo is now available on the Steam store page for new players to download and try Ember Crusade IV for free.

Happy crusading!

notes.title: Ember Crusade IV Post Launch Update
notes.content:
First off, thanks to everyone that purchased and played Ember Crusade IV. You're awesome!

Next, patch notes:

[list]
[*] Increased stability and performance.
[*] Reduced crashing.
[*] Reduced planetary bosses health pools by 10%-40%.
[/list]

notes.title: Ember Crusade IV is releasing tomorrow!
notes.content:
Ember Crusade IV is releasing [b]tomorrow (19 Aug 2022)[/b]. It's been a long road to release. Thanks for everyone who supported me, you're awesome!

So, some details:
[list]
[*] V1.0 will be releasing 19 Aug 2022 @ 8:00AM PDT
[*] Please use the "Send Feedback" button on the main menu to report any bugs.
[*] HMU on [url=https://twitter.com/MelktertMan]Twitter[/url] if you have any questions etc.
[/list]

Alright, deep breaths. Here we go guys!

notes.title: Ember Crusade IV DEMO now available
notes.content:
The Ember Crusade IV demo has now been launched on Steam and is available to download for free.

You can play on the first two planets: Triton and Callisto. Since we are still two months away from release there might be some bugs still present. Please take the time to submit feedback from main menu. This will help ensure the final release runs smoothly.

Thanks for playing and happy slaying!

notes.title: Ember Crusade IV is releasing on 19 August 2022
notes.content:
Ember Crusade IV will be releasing on [i]19 August 2022[/i]. [b]Wishlist[/b] the game in order to be informed when it releases.

Ember Crusade IV will also be getting a playable demo in June, so keep an eye out for it during the June Next Fest.
